title: Kloofendal 48d Partly Cloudy (Pure Sky)

bake.exposure_basis: Upper-hemisphere mean luminance normalized to 0.45; scale is shared with visible HDR background
bake.format: Little-endian SIB1 magic, 6 uint32 fields [magic,256,128,6,1024,512], float scale, float3 sun direction, float3 direct energy, 256x1024 RGB32F atlas, 1024x512 RGB32F source sky

limits: Filtered distant sky lighting, not local scene reflection capture or global illumination
Interior ambient still uses the existing bounded room approximation
Contact occlusion is screen-space and omits off-screen geometry and small secondary feeds
